item.title: Cocktail of the Day19 September 2026
item.description: If you're a user of emoticons, or even the humble :-) or :-( then you'll want to give Professor Scott E. Fahlman a big warm (), the emoticon for a hug, because this day in 1982, he suggested that, to take the heat off threads on bulletin boards, people could use the sign :-) for joking and :-( for serious.

item.title: Cocktail of the Day20 September 2026
item.description: Whether you're a collector of antique punch bowls, a fully-fledged punch anorak, or just a casual dabbler, the original spirits-based mixed drink, the punch, is certainly worth celebrating.

item.title: Cocktail of the Day21 September 2026
item.description: Today's the International Day of Peace, so by extension, also Paloma Day – the international symbol for peace is a white dove, and the Spanish word for dove is, of course, paloma. Coincidentally, our Managing Director is Paloma Difford and it's her birthday today.

item.title: Cocktail of the Day22 September 2026
item.description: White chocolate. Pale ivory in colour, buttery, milky and sweet tasting. It's a deliciously sweet treat for sure, but technically not considered chocolate at all due to the fact that it does not contain cocoa solids, unlike its milk and dark chocolate counterparts.
